desc:
⚾️ Superstar Baseball ⚡

💛 Like the game and join Metavision for a 500 COIN BONUS!!

Step up to the plate against other superstars in Superstar Baseball, an anime-inspired, action-packed 7v7 arcade baseball game! Use special abilities and ultimate power-ups to take control of the field and outplay your opponents in casual but high-stakes matchups.

🔥 Unlock unique playstyles with powerful abilities and ultimates
🧢 Easy to play, competitive, and fun for baseball fans of all levels
🎽 Collect and equip gear, with more cosmetic options dropping soon
💥 Feel like a true slugger in every swing, pitch, and diving catch
